https://www.trulia.com/building/ethos-ke.desc:
Welcome to Ethos Kelsey Boutique Luxury Apartments!

Discover an exceptional lifestyle at Ethos Kelsey, Belleville's newest luxury rental community. Perfectly blending modern sophistication with everyday convenience, Ethos Kelsey offers residents an unparalleled living experience in the heart of town. 

Stylish Residences 
Choose from beautifully designed studio, one and bedroom apartments, each featuring: 
- High-end finishes and fixtures, with custom finishes available
- Spacious open-concept layouts 
- Gourmet kitchens with quartz countertops 
- Spa-inspired bathrooms 
- In-unit washers and dryers 
- Expansive windows to invite natural light and stunning views 
- Balcony units 
Resort-Style Amenities
Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive access to: 
- Rooftop oasis featuring Belleville's first rooftop pool, breathtaking NYC views, private cabanas, Lounge and game areas 
- City Lights Lounge with firepit seating and BBQ station 
- State-of-the-art fitness center with 24/7 access 
- Meditation and sound therapy room for ultimate relaxation 
- Pet-friendly perks, including a dog run and pet spa 

Convenience at Your Fingertips 
- Onsite property management and 24/7 security cameras for peace of mind 
- Secure covered parking with electric vehicle charging stations 
- Package room with refrigerated storage for safe and fresh deliveries 
- Commercial laundry facilities with complementary services 
Work and Play 
- Resident lounges, including the Cherry Blossom Room and Third Wheel Lounge, ideal for relaxing, socializing, or enjoying billiards and arcade games 
- Two professional Zoom workspaces for remote work or meetings 
-Guest Suites

Prime Location
Located on Washington Avenue, Ethos Kelsey places you at the center of everything Belleville has to offer. Enjoy easy access to shopping, dining, entertainment, and major transportation hubs for a seamless commute to NYC and beyond. 

Experience the perfect harmony of luxury and convenience in boutique style living.

Apartments feature open-concept layouts, designer kitchens, in-home washers and dryers, and modern finishes. Amenities include a fitness center, resident lounge, secure package room, pet-friendly policies with an on-site dog run, and professionally managed, maintenance-free living. Located just steps from the Dover train station, 80East provides direct rail service to Penn Station in New York City while placing residents within walking distance of downtown Dover's restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, parks, and everyday conveniences. The combination of luxury amenities, a walkable downtown, and convenient access to New York City makes 80East the best place to live in Dover.
